name: Ward Wi-Fi partition with drifted bedside clocks

assertions.title: Some bedside monitors stamp readings ahead of the true time
No future-dated reading reaches clinicians without being flagged and corrected
The cut ward link is reported as a suspected partition although both services report healthy
Readings that cannot cross the cut link are held for retry or dead-lettered, not dropped
Readings taken during the partition are processed once the link heals
Every expected alert is eventually delivered
Nothing is lost for any reason other than the injected faults
